title: C-EVAL: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Permuting the order of multiple-choice options to evaluate if models exhibit a statistical preference for certain option letters (e.g., A, B, C, D) regardless of the actual content, and measuring the variance in accuracy across different permutations.

Evaluating and comparing foundation models on C-EVAL, a benchmark explicitly designed with a Chinese cultural and linguistic context (including subjects like Chinese history, politics, and law), to expose limitations and knowledge gaps in models predominantly trained on English and Western-centric data.
